L10: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
L10: Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
L10: Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
L10: Mode fault / collision detection.
L10: All clock polarity/phase combinations.
L10: MSB-first vs LSB-first byte ordering.
L10: Bidirectional mode (single data pin).
L10: Receive overrun (flag-serviced-too-late).
L10: Baud rate divisor sweep.
L10: Wait/Stop mode behavior.
L16: Master Reset clears IER/IIR/LCR/MCR/FCR; sets LSR to 0x60; sets outputs to inactive (Table I).
L16: After reset, FIFO is disabled (16450 mode) until FCR.0 is set.
L16: Baud rate divisor must be in range 1..65535 (DLM:DLL).
L16: Character frame = 1 start bit + 5-8 data bits LSB-first + optional parity + 1, 1.5, or 2 stop bits HIGH.
L16: Receiver oversampling = 16×; mid-bit sampling at the 8th BAUDOUT clock.
L16: False start-bit detection: re-sample 8 clocks after edge; reject if SIN returned HIGH.
L16: DLAB=1 remaps registers 0/1 to DLL/DLM; DLAB=0 restores RBR/THR + IER mapping.
L16: INTR is the OR of all enabled interrupts; IIR.0=0 indicates interrupt pending.
L16: LSR.OE/PE/FE/BI are cleared by reading LSR.
L16: MSR delta bits (DCTS/DDSR/TERI/DDCD) are cleared by reading MSR.
L16: Loopback mode (MCR.4=1): SOUT internally connected to SIN; modem outputs drive modem inputs; transmitter SOUT pin is HIG
